notes: A/B/C differ only in the sign texture (A red, B blue, C green); the body, post, geometry and mass stay identical. The 200x160x150 dimensions refer to the open bin body; the entry lip, post and 120x80 sign enlarge its total bbox. Lip width is measured along the 30 mm sloping sheet, rising 30 degrees above horizontal toward -X to guide a parcel into the bin. All parts are recentered together to the complete bottom-bbox centre, not independently. The bin remains open; exactly six proxies represent floor, four walls and entry lip. The post/sign are decorative and intentionally noncolliding under the prescribed six-piece budget. The 0.8 kg total is the specified static effective mass. Metres, Z up, front -X; all meshes and proxies share the prop origin and identity transforms. Smart UV 66 degrees with 0.01 island margins; 30-degree split smoothing and exported normals. Albedo is CPU Cycles 64-sample diffuse COLOR * (0.4 + 0.6 * AO), 8-bit sRGB; no direct light or highlights. Full procedural Principled PBR and source label UVs are packed in source.blend. Colour grain is centred on nominal colour with about +/-3 percent variation. Generated with Blender 5.2.0 LTS. Task 13 compact OBJ exception: positions use 5 decimal metres where safe; necessary vertices retain up to 6 decimals to preserve nonzero triangles, strict collision convexity and the 0.005 mm Euclidean movement bound. Independent fixed-5 rounding cannot satisfy all three. Normals/UVs use 4 decimals; every original triangle, position index and per-corner attribute value is retained. Equal rounded UV records share indices and visual OBJ indices use shorter equivalent relative notation. No collision remeshing, reindexing or simplification. Task 13 delivery: baked albedos are Lanczos-downsampled to at most 1024 px except the unchanged-resolution factory-floor repeat tile; previews are 512 square. PNG encoding uses RGB8 or reviewed 256-colour Floyd-Steinberg palettes; source artwork pixels and source.blend are retained. Shared PNG paths resolve from this prop folder.
